channel.title: Writing and projects by Joe Conlin
channel.description: Recent writing and projects by Joe Conlin.

item.title: Whisker & Claw
item.description: A browser game where you run a cat-only vet clinic like a tabletop RPG, and a d20 decides how cleanly your medicine goes.

item.title: Cat Food Calculator
item.description: A vet-designed calculator that works out how much to feed a cat, built for my wife’s channel, Cat Repairwoman.

item.title: Pizza Scorecard
item.description: A small web app for scoring pizza spots on crust, sauce, cheese, and overall flavor, with a group leaderboard.

item.title: Patchbook
item.description: A local-first studio reference app for equipment, patches, manuals, and project notes.

item.title: VFD Maker
item.description: A browser tool for composing and exporting images in the style of a Roland JX-8P display.
